scopeReview: CED FUN-6.C.1–3: indefinite integrals and primitive families from known derivative rules, linearity and power-rule exception −1. Basic sine, cosine, exponential, tangent, inverse-tangent and inverse-sine primitives respect their real domains. C is constant on a connected interval; disconnected components are treated independently. No integration by parts or partial fractions appears; closed-form availability is not assumed for arbitrary functions.
varietyReview: Polynomial sum, negative power versus logarithm exception, logarithm on a negative interval, basic cosine, mixed signed trigonometric sum, exponential versus product confusion, secant-square pole/domain checks, inverse tangent, inverse sine, the full constant family for zero integrand and separate constants on disconnected intervals. Nine candidate-derivative computations with independently stated exact proofs; conceptual family/domain assertions are separately reviewed.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
